Historical full-card image of [[BoShek's Modified Light Freighter (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith) (Original)|BoShek's Modified Light Freighter]], matching the [[Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.

== Source ==
* Package: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/holotable/windows/holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe] (Story #419).
* Distribution member: <code>cards/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/bosheksmodifiedlightfreighter.gif</code>.
